verdict.rationale: cubic documents generating PR descriptions and summaries from code changes, configurable via cubic.yaml. A changelog note mentions group descriptions shown beside the diff, which hints at a grouped change walkthrough in cubic's own PR UI. That walkthrough is only implied by one changelog line, and the AI PR-descriptions page sits in an archive section. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a file-by-file or grouped change walkthrough posted on the PR, explicit confirmation that summaries are generated automatically on every PR, and independent or hands-on corroboration of summary quality.

support.subject: As a developer, every PR gets an auto-generated summary and change walkthrough so human reviewers orient fast

citations.quote: PR summaries: Generates PR descriptions based on code changes
cubic helps your team spend less time writing PR descriptions automatically by generating clear, concise summaries.
Now, the group description stays beside the diff as you scroll, so you can read the code and its explanation together.
Once installed, cubic automatically reviews new pull requests.
